source: Temperatures: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020, monthly, Chicago O'Hare International Airport (USW00094846), MLY-TAVG-NORMAL, with the monthly normal highs and lows (MLY-TMAX-NORMAL, MLY-TMIN-NORMAL) used for the modeled hourly temperature (annual normals 5,974 heating and 1,003 cooling degree days, base 65 F; Midway: 5,753 and 1,111).
